title: Investment Research Q&A Copilot

blueprintSignals.name: Citation validity
blueprintSignals.definition: share of claims whose cited passage entails the claim
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: A passage may exist and not support the claim, so test entailment

blueprintSignals.name: Retrieval recall
blueprintSignals.definition: share of questions where the gold passage is in the top k
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Gold sets are costly to build, so sample across sectors

blueprintSignals.name: Abstention precision
blueprintSignals.definition: share of refusals that were correct because the evidence was missing
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Over-refusal lowers usefulness, so track both

blueprintSignals.name: Freshness
blueprintSignals.definition: age in days of each cited source against the latest available version
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Dating metadata are often missing or wrong

engineFeatures.meaning: narrow queries for context and evidence, with no free-form shell or query language

label: For "Investment Research Q&A Copilot": Answer analysts' questions from the firm's research notes, filings and data with citations and clear abstention. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Evaluating on questions where the relevant notes are known flatters retrieval.
